First, 8 weeks + 7 days = 8×7 + 7 = 56 + 7 = 63 days.  
Subtract 63 days from 1053-11-15.  
November has 30 days, so 15 − 63: go back into October.  
October 31 is 15 days before Nov 15, so 63 − 15 = 48 days earlier from Oct 31.  
October has 31 days, so Oct 31 − 48 days:  
Oct 31 → Oct 1 is 30 days earlier, leaves 18 more days back into September.  
September has 30 days, so Sept 30 is 1 day before Oct 1, so 18 − 1 = 17 more days: Sept 30 → Sept 13.  
Thus 1053-09-13.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1053-09-13
